page_title: CAG 0-0 LAZ | Cagliari v Lazio 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
90+4' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
90+1' Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.

90+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nuno Tavares (Lazio). Lazio have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Yael Trepy (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
88' Substitution. Semih Kilicsoy walks off the pitch and Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.
87' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the bottom left corner, but Elia Caprile denies him.
86' Lazio get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
85' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
85' Substitution. Mattia Zaccagni leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
84' Adam Marusic (Lazio) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the right post.
80' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
78' Great solo effort from Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post.
75' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
73' Today's match ends for Sebastiano Esposito who will be replaced by Yael Trepy (Cagliari).
72' Maurizio Sarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nuno Tavares (Lazio) replacing Luca Pellegrini.
72' Daniel Maldini comes off the pitch to be replaced by Petar Ratkov (Lazio).
70' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
68' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Marco Palestra (Cagliari) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
67' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes.
65' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went to the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel made an easy save.
64' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' Daniel Maldini (Lazio) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
63' Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
62' 49:51 – the ratio of ball possession.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) is coming onto the pitch as Gustav Isaksen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
60' Maurizio Sarri is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Nicolo Rovella suffers an injury and Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) comes on.
59' Looks like Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
57' The game is interrupted now, Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jose Pedro (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Elia Caprile makes a good save! Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
52' That's a well-taken pass by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
51' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle after Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
50' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) probably handled the ball inside the penalty area.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Jose Pedro (Cagliari) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' Referee Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Antonio Rapuano shows a yellow card to Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' Problems for Fabio Pisacane as Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Riyad Idrissi replaces him.
39' 0:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
38' A cross from a corner kick by Lazio is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
37' CHANCE! Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
36' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.
33' Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
32' The ball is out of play. Cagliari win a corner kick.
32' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
29' A pass by Adam Marusic (Lazio) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
27' Elia Caprile pulls off a glorious save! Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) attempts to head home after a precise lofted cross. However, his effort only finds its way into the goalkeeper gloves.
26' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
24' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
22' Ball possession – 48:52.
20' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends a wild header high over the bar.
19' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
19' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) who loops his header high over the bar.
16' Some neat passing and movement from Cagliari as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
14' What a miss! The corner finds Jose Pedro (Cagliari) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
12' Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
7' Great teamplay by Lazio as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' A quickly taken corner by Lazio.
2' Lazio have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Antonio Rapuano.
